caseName: American Refrigerator Transit Co. v. Wabash Railway Co.
caseNameFull: American Refrigerator Transit Company v. Wabash Railway Company
attorneys: Messrs. C. A. De-Gersdorff, T. H. Devine, M. W. Hayden, and Edward J. White for petitioner. Messrs. Winslow S. Pierce and Homer Hall for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied. The motions for leave to intervene on behalf of the States of New Jersey,Missouri, and Texas are also denied.
